purpose: Permanent requirements-to-evidence preflight map for the MoolSocial Flutter Android Google authentication release path.
privacy: The map and its checks must never store or emit API keys, OAuth client values, certificate fingerprints, tokens, credentials, account identities, email addresses, Firebase UIDs, secrets, or raw exception messages.
ticketGenerationRule: Create a fix ticket only for FAIL or P0 production-critical NOT_VERIFIED requirements. Reuse the mapped ticket when present. Do not create tickets for PASS, NOT_APPLICABLE, or deferred P1 evidence work.
stableEvidenceRule: Reuse PASS and NOT_APPLICABLE evidence. Reverify only when a requirement's reverifyWhen trigger occurs. A new APK triggers only APK-, signer-, runtime-, Firebase-result-, and session/UI-dependent checks; it does not reopen unrelated stable console facts.

gatePhases.pre_build: All P0 implementation and configuration requirements assigned to pre_build must be PASS or NOT_APPLICABLE.
gatePhases.post_install_acceptance: The real OPPO must prove Google identity return, Firebase acceptance, Firebase user/session creation, authenticated UI transition, and relaunch persistence. APK build success cannot satisfy this phase.
